_comment: NEURONSHOW vast path smoke (infra/vast/operations/2026-10-26_neuronshow_path.md). 24-50 GB single GPU (gpu_ram is in GB of 1000 MB: <=50 keeps the 48 GB L40S / A6000 / 6000Ada class, >=24 keeps the 4090 / 3090 / A5000 class); compute_cap>=800 is the bf16 floor (drops Turing); cuda_vers>=13.0 because mdl-v1 is torch 2.12.0+cu130; cpu_ram>=30 because a host with ~12 GB per slot starves a 7B load. Image shackleton:mdl-v1 = deps only (torch 2.12.0, transformers 5.9.0, awscli, vastai), pulled during unbilled loading. Weights from the Hub in-run (weights_mode download + HF_ONLINE=1, no weights_hf_repo, so lifecycle's own download block is skipped and the offer filter adds inet_down>=800); HF_TOKEN from SSM via controller.py. Cell 1: smoke_stats loads Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base from the Hub on the GPU in bf16 and runs one forward. Cell 2: module_job runs the weight-free NEURONRW dry run (tiny random Gemma 3, all three stages, CPU) and syncs it to results/mdl/neurons/show/0/dryrun_gemma3/. pg_git_sha 9acbf7fe holds the shipped code; the commit that adds this manifest changes no code. max_billed_h 0.5 is about 5x the expected 6 billed minutes.
